request.hypothesis: The cart and checkout journeys will experience increased error rates and latency due to cart update failures. The system should not lose cart data (stored in redis-cart) but may show stale cart states.
request.reason: cartservice is critical with high fan-in (2 callers: checkoutservice and frontend). It is directly involved in both the cart (554 requests) and checkout (188 requests) journeys. This failure mode tests the stateful interaction with redis-cart (already validated in prior tests) without repeating redis-cart failures.
